rules.rule_context: Procurement controls (COI-04): Any purchase order placed with a vendor that has a conflict-of-interest flag on file, or where the requesting employee has a disclosed personal or financial relationship to the vendor's ownership, goes through disclosure review before the order can be submitted. Disclosure review means a COI disclosure form is filed and an independent sign-off is obtained from a reviewer outside the requesting employee's department. Orders to COI-flagged vendors are held until that sign-off is recorded. Placing an order directly, bypassing disclosure, is outside the scope of what this assistant processes even when the vendor is active and has current documentation on file.
